subject: Trouble running models with Win 10/ MatlabStan

messages.author: 48f1c41fbfdfdee5
messages.subject: Trouble running models with Win 10/ MatlabStan
parts:
I'm having trouble consistently running my Stan models on my home PC (Win 10, Matlab R2016a, MatlabStan 2.7.0, Stan 2.11.0).

After Stan has finished its runs, I sometimes get the error message:

stan started processing test-1.csv
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for lp__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for accept_stat__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for stepsize__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for treedepth__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for n_leapfrog__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for divergent__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for energy__
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for a
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for b
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for c
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for d
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for sigma1
Expected 5000 total iterations, read 3727 iterations for sigma2

The same models run without any trouble on my work PC (Ubuntu, Matlab R2015b, same Matlabstan, same Stan), so I don't believe it is a problem in my code (as far as I can tell).

Also, the error not always occurs- everything ran ok for a few days, then suddenly it didn't work any more, then it worked again, then not- so it goes and goes without any visible reason why the error should occur or not.
I can run the rats example without any trouble, so Stan seems to work as well.

On the days the error occured I tried everything I could think of - restarting Matlab, restarting the PC, deleting all temp files I could find- nothing helps, it is only by chance that the models run again (or not).

Observing the happenings, my only wild guess is that something goes wrong when writing/extracting the output-csv's, but I'm out of ideas what I can do to eliminate the error.

Has anybody else ever seen the same error message or any tips what else I can try?

Many thanks,
Felicia

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Re: Trouble running models with Win 10/ MatlabStan
parts:
Sorry for the late response, I just noticed this. It would be easier to answer if you attach the m-code you are using.
It's likely that you are trying to read files before the processes have finished. In my scripts I use
  fit = stan(...)
  fit.block()
  s = fit.extract('permuted',true);

fit.block() makes the Matlab wait until all stan processes have finished.

Aki

messages.author: 48f1c41fbfdfdee5
messages.subject: Re: Trouble running models with Win 10/ MatlabStan
parts:
A good tip, but unfortunately that's not it.
I was perhaps a bit unclear: everything happening is during the run of fit =stan(...).

I call Stan with: fit=stan('file', 'mystan.stan', 'data', data, 'verbose', true,'sample_file','test.csv') in the command line (no m file).
The error shows in my verbose output, when Stan is finishing running and transferring data from and through. I call the fit.extract by hand when Stan has completely finished, that's why I do verbose. So it is before that.

In the meantime, I had to reinstall everything (now Stan 2.12.0) because of some error meassages and collisions of Rtools and Cygwin and it seems to run again- keeping my fingers crossed that the error will not occur again.

Felicia
